commands: docker build -t moltline-mcp . && docker run -i --rm moltline-mcp timeops

notes: No auth is required for the free tier. Premium tools take a licence as the X-Moltline-License request header; the stdio bridge reads it from the MOLTLINE_LICENSE environment variable and deliberately keeps it out of argv and out of the URL.
